examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A generated SQL query with three versions in a resizable side pane next to the conversation: the pager switches versions, Copy copies the version shown, Close hides the pane and Open in the message brings it back with focus on its title.

examples.name: Table
examples.summary: A generated table with one version and Download; Regenerate marks the canvas as streaming, which locks the pager and marks the body busy until the new version arrives.
